prompt.project_info: A quiet reading portrait in a sunlit library loft, balancing warm architectural lines, book texture, and natural backlight.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long dark loose waves, minimal makeup, natural skin texture, and a reflective off-camera gaze. She sits sideways on a bench holding an open book, dressed in a deep-black velvet midi dress with a modest V neckline and long sleeves.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium vertical portrait with the subject right-weighted under tall grid windows. Soft flare and a book edge create foreground layers; book-filled wooden shelves and window lines lead into the blurred background. Keep pages unprinted or unreadable and omit logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong side-back golden-hour window light at approximately 3800K creates volumetric rays, dust particles, a subtle lens flare, soft bloom, and warm amber contrast with neutral shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, vertical 3:4 crop, slightly low eye-level, focus on eyes and face plane, shallow creamy background, film-like dynamic range, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic editorial portrait of an adult woman with long dark loose waves, seated sideways on a bench in a sunlit library loft and holding an open book. She wears a deep-black velvet long-sleeve midi dress with a modest V neckline, natural makeup, and a calm reflective off-camera gaze. Tall grid windows, wooden bookshelves, warm interior tones, dust particles in the air, and golden-hour side-back window light create volumetric rays, soft flare, and gentle bloom. Medium vertical portrait, eyes in focus, realistic velvet and skin texture, film-like warm amber grading, book pages without readable text, no logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed hands

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach approved adult identity, wardrobe, or location references only where consistency matters. Preserve the open-book gesture, covered black velvet dress, loft windows, shelves, and golden backlight; the subject, book, and library can be replaced with approved assets while avoiding any readable book text or branding.
